repositories.description: Taste-Skill - gives your AI good taste. stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop
repositories.description_zh: 一个试图提升 AI 审美和输出品味的 skill，让 AI 少生成平庸、模板化、缺乏判断力的内容。

repositories.description: A hand-picked collection of the finest of resources for the most awesome of agents, Claude Code, the undisputed champion of coding companions, from the unstoppable team at Anthropic PBC. A delectable showcase of top tier skills, ambidextrous agents, scintillating status lines, top notch developer tooling, and also we have plugins
repositories.description_zh: 一份精选 Claude Code 资源合集，整理高质量 skills、agents、状态栏、开发者工具和插件等生态内容。

repositories.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repositories.description_zh: 面向 Claude Code 和 AI agents 的营销 skills 集合，覆盖 CRO、文案、SEO、分析和增长工程。

repositories.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
repositories.description_zh: 利用普通 WiFi 信号实现实时空间感知、生命体征监测和存在检测，无需摄像头视频画面。
Gas Town 是一个多 agent 工作区管理器，用于组织、调度和管理多个 AI agents 的协作环境。

repositories.description: Persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents and long-running agentic tasks. Crash-proof markdown plans that survive context loss and /clear, plus a deterministic completion gate and multi-agent shared state on disk. Manus-style. Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode and 60+ agents via the SKILL.md standard.
repositories.description_zh: 一个面向 AI coding agents 和长任务的持久化文件计划系统，用 Markdown 保存计划、完成门槛和多 agent 共享状态，避免上下文丢失影响任务推进。

repositories.description: Show usage stats for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, without having to login.
repositories.description_zh: 一个 macOS 菜单栏工具，可在不登录的情况下查看 OpenAI Codex 和 Claude Code 的使用统计。

repositories.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
repositories.description_zh: Anthropic 推出的终端式 agentic 编程工具，可理解代码库、执行日常开发任务、解释代码并协助提升编码效率。

repositories.description: Practical patterns, starters & CLI tools for loop engineering with AI coding agents. Design systems that prompt and orchestrate agents (inspired by Addy Osmani and Boris Cherny). Includes loop-audit, loop-init, loop-cost.
repositories.description_zh: 一组面向 AI coding agents 的 loop engineering 实践模式、启动模板和 CLI 工具，用于设计能提示并编排 agents 的系统。

repositories.description: OpenWiki is a CLI that writes and maintains agent documentation for your codebase.
repositories.description_zh: LangChain 的 OpenWiki CLI，可为代码库生成并维护面向 agents 的项目文档。
